# ClickGUI

**Category:** Misc  
**Aliases:** ClickGui, ClickGUI

## What it does

ClickGUI opens the main menu where you browse, toggle, and configure every module in LiquidBounce. By default it's bound to Right Shift — press it in-game to bring up the interface, search for what you need, and tweak settings without leaving your session. This is the central hub from which you'll manage everything from KillAura to ESP .

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/render/clickgui). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
